name: Transform
overview: Scripture calls believers to a profound transformation that begins with offering themselves as living sacrifices to God, signifying a holy and acceptable dedication (Romans 12:1). This transformation involves a renewal of the mind, enabling Christians to discern and live out God's perfect will rather than conforming to worldly patterns (Romans 12:2). Believers are called to walk as children of light, reflecting their new identity in Christ who has delivered them from darkness (Ephesians 5:8). Furthermore, enduring temptation faithfully is part of this transformative journey, promising the crown of life to those who love the Lord (James 1:12).
